set.body: Extend the isolated Unicode service with real line-dependent L1 levels and L2 codepoint visual maps, paragraph base levels and explicit X9 omissions. Use pinned upstream bidi algorithms through pointer-only boundaries in the same Rust library. Run the complete pinned BidiCharacterTest corpus plus wrapped-line, supplementary/combining, ownership and invalid range tests. Keep glyph shaping/fallback, layout/carets/UI hosting and full P0.8 size/platform gates open. Preserve kernel work and run testJVM, testNative and native artifact suites.
set.title: G-0/P0.8: Resolve bidi lines and qualify source-preserving visual maps
